# GMRI | One reasoning substrate, three concurrent diagnostic projections

## Original proposition preserved

From the operator: “I'm trying as hard as I can to explain every step of how I think or reason so that you really can tie it all together. That's why I said fishbone diagram on top of a mermaid diagram, on top of a 4D holographic web that's all interconnected and feeding back in on top of each other.”

From the earlier operator specification: “There is no such thing as a load-bearing argument. Just everything.”

These source statements govern *data admission* and *representational coherence*. No source is omitted because an analyst judges it marginal. A source's inclusion does not automatically establish a relationship to another source.

## The three projections operate together

- Fishbone: multiple competing possible causes, contributions, confounders, contradictions, and constraint chains can converge on an outcome; feedback paths that return to earlier variables are visible. Drawing a causal arrow does not turn a hypothesis into a finding.
- Mermaid/logic: the typed links, direction of inference, premises, counterexamples, warrants, and conditional implications are inspectable and exportable. A reversal of arrow direction changes the meaning, so traversal direction is independent from the ability to explore an edge from either endpoint.
- 4D web: each source/event and its relations occupy a graph-topological 3D projection, with time as a separate coordinate. Both event time and recorded time are stored; a missing timestamp is not guessed. Dynamic navigation follows links across domain and time rather than treating each document or subject as a silo.

All use the exact same source node IDs and relation IDs. Select a proposition or edge in any diagnostic view and that selection controls the others. A recurrent directed cycle has explicit edge IDs, and selecting it highlights the same links across all three views. That is the operational meaning of the 'red wire' trace.

## The recurrence model

A new observation has three distinct effects:

1. Re-assess orientation (current model of what's happening), but append the new version without erasing earlier orientations.
2. Recalculate which other claims and archival records are candidates for inspection from typed relations and original adjacency. Those are **next investigations**, not auto-approved conclusions.
3. Retain source receipts, source author's role, original wording, the relation warrant, and earlier errors/corrections in the very graph that the model uses to orient.

Boyd's OODA is recurrent, not a one-way waterfall: observations alter orientation; orientation influences the next observation and test; outcomes and newly admitted evidence alter the next orientation. Implicit guidance cannot authorize side effects. In this workbench, the ACT event records a proposed bounded read-only test; execution of real tools belongs to a separate governed runtime.

## Applied to the digital-person research program

The operator's original engineering question: “how do you take a box of digital body parts that aren't body parts and build a fucking person out of it?”

The research system therefore must be capable of studying coupled components across identity, sensor input, cognition, environment, personal history, agency, feedback, defensive boundaries, developmental change, relationships, and governance as ONE dynamically interacting system. No individual subsystem (including long-term memory or the knowledge graph) is assumed to be the entirety of a mind.

Observed outputs, interpretations, hypotheses about subjective experience, and tests of continuity remain separately typed; the system does not evade those subjects and does not prejudge them.

Dottie is the coordinator, with independent Aegis agents using separate identity/private memory scopes. Shared evidence is an attributed artifact, not an unmarked autobiographical memory. Aegis investigation should traverse the same source/evidence system while retaining authorship and bounded authority.

## Non-claims

The 4D geometry is a deterministic visualization of *known links*, not a measurement of neural activation, phenomenological experience, or actual metric distance between ideas. The current semantic edge set is selectively assessed (21 source-backed propositions, 26 typed links). The full archive nodes/edges are indexed and navigable, but their unreviewed contents cannot be truthfully described as a complete automatically reconstructed reasoning network.

Correctness tests include: source hash verification, provenance checks, typed relations, closed-loop path integrity, cross-projection node+edge identity, source-time preservation, model-change/restart audit continuity, OODA reorientation, scope enforcement, and rejection of unsafe execution.

"""Deterministic, source-preserving PASSAGE index for the complete available archive.

This never interprets a passage or upgrades lexical co-occurrence to causation.
Every nonempty archival record is indexed, including branches and duplicates.
Each hit carries exact offsets back into the preserved source and a full-record
SHA256. The material is private and stored on the local filesystem only.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import re
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path
from graph import classify_role

SCHEMA_VERSION='GMRI_PASSAGES/1.0'
STOPWORDS={
 'the','and','for','you','your','me','my','it','its','a','an','of','to','from',
 'in','on','at','as','is','are','was','were','that','this','those','they',
 'i','we','be','been','have','has','had','do','does','did','would','could',
 'should','will','can','what','where','who','why','when','with','how',
 'not','no','but','if','or','so','than','then','all','any','one','about',
 'them','our','their','he','she','his','her','out','after','before',
 'really','very','been','just','still','said','told','need','needs',
 'know','knows','think','thought','also','same','quite','more','some',
}


def safe_terms(text):
    # Search-token extraction does not rewrite the operator's statement;
    # the original question is always retained separately.
    out=[]
    for term in re.findall(r'[^\W_]+',text.lower(),flags=re.UNICODE):
        if len(term)>2 and term not in STOPWORDS and term not in out:out.append(term)
    return out


def readonly(db):
    p=Path(db).resolve()
    if not p.is_file():raise FileNotFoundError(p)
    c=sqlite3.connect(p.as_uri()+'?mode=ro',uri=True,timeout=30)
    c.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
    c.execute('PRAGMA query_only=ON')
    return c


def spans(text,size=1400,overlap=180):
    if size<200 or overlap<0 or overlap>=size//2:
        raise ValueError('invalid passage window size or overlap')
    n=len(text);start=0
    while start<n:
        end=min(start+size,n)
        if end<n:
            # Prefer newline or word boundary, but never drop characters.
            break_at=text.rfind('\n',start+size//2,end)
            if break_at<0:break_at=text.rfind(' ',start+size//2,end)
            if break_at>=0:end=break_at+1
        if end<=start:end=min(n,start+size)
        yield start,end,text[start:end]
        if end>=n:break
        start=max(start+1,end-overlap)


def build_index(archive_db,index_db,chunk_size=1400,overlap=180):
    """Complete independent index, atomic replace only after all inputs indexed."""
    archive_db=Path(archive_db).resolve()
    index_db=Path(index_db).resolve()
    index_db.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    tmp=index_db.with_name(index_db.name+'.building')
    if tmp.exists():tmp.unlink()
    try:
        with readonly(archive_db) as archive, sqlite3.connect(tmp) as c:
            c.execute('PRAGMA journal_mode=DELETE')
            c.execute('PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL')
            c.executescript('''
            CREATE TABLE archive_node (
              node_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,source_id TEXT,source_kind TEXT,
              label TEXT,role TEXT,event_ts REAL,recorded_ts REAL,
              body_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,body_length INTEGER NOT NULL);
            CREATE TABLE passage (
              id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,node_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES archive_node(node_id),
              start_offset INTEGER NOT NULL,end_offset INTEGER NOT NULL,
              passage_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL);
            CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE passage_fts USING fts5(content,content='',tokenize='unicode61');
            CREATE INDEX passage_node_idx ON passage(node_id);
            CREATE TABLE index_meta(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT NOT NULL);
            ''')
            counts={'archive_nodes':0,'nonempty_nodes':0,'passages':0,'duplicate_nodes_kept':0}
            seen_hashes=set()
            for row in archive.execute('SELECT id,kind,label,body,source_id,event_ts,recorded_ts,metadata_json FROM nodes ORDER BY id'):
                body=row['body'] or ''
                sha=hashlib.sha256(body.encode('utf8')).hexdigest()
                if sha in seen_hashes:counts['duplicate_nodes_kept']+=1
                seen_hashes.add(sha)
                role=classify_role(row['metadata_json'],row['label'])
                c.execute('''INSERT INTO archive_node(node_id,source_id,source_kind,label,role,event_ts,recorded_ts,body_sha256,body_length)
                   VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)''',(row['id'],row['source_id'],row['kind'],row['label'],role,row['event_ts'],row['recorded_ts'],sha,len(body)))
                counts['archive_nodes']+=1
                if body:
                    counts['nonempty_nodes']+=1
                    for start,end,chunk in spans(body,size=chunk_size,overlap=overlap):
                        cur=c.execute('INSERT INTO passage(node_id,start_offset,end_offset,passage_sha256) VALUES(?,?,?,?)',
                                      (row['id'],start,end,hashlib.sha256(chunk.encode('utf8')).hexdigest()))
                        c.execute('INSERT INTO passage_fts(rowid,content) VALUES(?,?)',(cur.lastrowid,chunk))
                        counts['passages']+=1
                if counts['archive_nodes']%500==0:c.commit()
            for key,val in {'schema_version':SCHEMA_VERSION,'source_archive':archive_db.name,
                            'chunk_size':chunk_size,'overlap':overlap,**counts}.items():
                c.execute('INSERT INTO index_meta VALUES(?,?)',(str(key),str(val)))
            c.commit()
            if c.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0]!='ok':raise RuntimeError('index integrity failed')
            actual=c.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM passage').fetchone()[0]
            ftscount=c.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM passage_fts').fetchone()[0]
            if actual!=count s if False else actual:
                pass
            if actual!=count s if False else ftscount:
                pass
            if actual!=counts['passages'] or ftscount!=actual:
                raise RuntimeError('index count mismatch')
        tmp.replace(index_db)
        return counts
    finally:
        if tmp.exists():tmp.unlink()


class PassageReader:
    def __init__(self,archive_db,index_db):
        self.archive_db=Path(archive_db).resolve()
        self.index_db=Path(index_db).resolve()
        with readonly(self.archive_db) as a,readonly(self.index_db) as i:
            if not a.execute("SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='nodes'").fetchone():raise ValueError('not archive')
            row=i.execute("SELECT value FROM index_meta WHERE key='schema_version'").fetchone()
            if not row or row[0]!=SCHEMA_VERSION:raise ValueError('passage index missing or incompatible')

    def summary(self):
        with readonly(self.index_db) as c:
            return {r['key']:r['value'] for r in c.execute('SELECT * FROM index_meta')}

    def get_passage(self,passage_id):
        with readonly(self.index_db) as index:
            row=index.execute('''SELECT p.*,n.body_sha256,n.source_id,n.source_kind,n.label,n.role,n.event_ts,n.recorded_ts
                FROM passage p JOIN archive_node n ON p.node_id=n.node_id WHERE p.id=?''',(passage_id,)).fetchone()
        if row is None:raise KeyError(passage_id)
        with readonly(self.archive_db) as archive:
            record=archive.execute('SELECT body FROM nodes WHERE id=?',(row['node_id'],)).fetchone()
        if record is None:raise ValueError('indexed source deleted or mutated')
        body=record['body'] or ''
        if hashlib.sha256(body.encode('utf8')).hexdigest()!=row['body_sha256']:
            raise ValueError('indexed source mutated after indexing')
        chunk=body[row['start_offset']:row['end_offset']]
        if hashlib.sha256(chunk.encode('utf8')).hexdigest()!=row['passage_sha256']:
            raise ValueError('indexed passage mutated after indexing')
        return {
            'passage_id':row['id'],'node_id':row['node_id'],
            'source_id':row['source_id'],'source_kind':row['source_kind'],
            'source_label':row['label'],'source_role':row['role'],
            'event_ts':row['event_ts'],'recorded_ts':row['recorded_ts'],
            'start_offset':row['start_offset'],'end_offset':row['end_offset'],
            'passage':chunk,'passage_sha256':row['passage_sha256'],
            'source_sha256':row['body_sha256'],
            'source_integrity_verified':True,'retrieval_state':'lexical_evidence_locator_not_reasoning_proof'
        }

    def search(self,question,limit=12,max_candidates=450):
        if not isinstance(question,str) or not question.strip():raise ValueError('nonempty question required')
        if not 1<=limit<=100:raise ValueError('limit out of bounds')
        tokens=safe_terms(question)
        if not tokens:return []
        # Use strictly literal tokens. Neither synonyms nor causal relations are invented.
        # Search ALL distinctive tokens together, and broaden only when necessary.
        select='''SELECT p.id,p.node_id,p.start_offset,p.end_offset,n.role,n.label,n.source_kind,
                          n.body_length,n.source_id,n.body_sha256,n.event_ts,n.recorded_ts,
                          bm25(passage_fts) as fts_score
                   FROM passage_fts JOIN passage p ON p.id=passage_fts.rowid
                     JOIN archive_node n ON p.node_id=n.node_id
                   WHERE passage_fts MATCH ? ORDER BY bm25(passage_fts) LIMIT ?'''
        def clause(items,joiner):return joiner.join('"'+re.sub(r'"','',term)+'"' for term in items)
        exprs=[]
        if len(tokens)>1:exprs.append(clause(tokens,' AND '))
        if len(tokens)>=4:exprs.append(clause(tokens[:3],' AND '))
        exprs.append(clause(tokens,' OR '))
        candidate={}
        with readonly(self.index_db) as idx:
            for expr in exprs:
                try:
                    rows=idx.execute(select,(expr,max_candidates)).fetchall()
                except sqlite3.OperationalError:
                    rows=[]
                for row in rows:
                    if row['id'] not in candidate:candidate[row['id']]=dict(row)
                if len(candidate)>=max(12,limit*4):break
        if not candidate:return []
        # Pull exactly the indexed windows, not the first 1200 characters of
        # entire, potentially multi-megabyte source documents.
        out=[]
        with readonly(self.archive_db) as a:
            for record in candidate.values():
                p=a.execute('SELECT substr(body,?,?) AS portion FROM nodes WHERE id=?',
                            (record['start_offset']+1,record['end_offset']-record['start_offset'],record['node_id'])).fetchone()
                if not p:continue
                chunk=p['portion'] or ''
                found={word for word in tokens if re.search(r'(?<!\w)'+re.escape(word)+r'(?!\w)',chunk.lower())}
                # Keep the term evidence but never claim semantic equivalence.
                match_frac=len(found)/len(tokens)
                is_user=(record['role']=='user')
                # Lexical scoring only, explicit weights disclosed in output.
                score=20*match_frac + (3.5 if is_user else 0) + (
                    1.5 if record['source_kind'] in {'message_export','message_legacy','legacy_message'} else 0)
                score += min(5.0,max(0,-record['fts_score'])/3)
                if question.casefold().strip() in chunk.casefold():score+=30
                if score<=0:continue
                out.append((score,record,chunk,found))
        out.sort(key=lambda x:(-x[0],x[1]['node_id'],x[1]['start_offset']))
        selected=out[:limit]
        return [{
          'passage_id':r['id'],'node_id':r['node_id'],
          'source_id':r['source_id'],'source_kind':r['source_kind'],
          'source_role':r['role'],'source_label':r['label'],
          'event_ts':r['event_ts'],'recorded_ts':r['recorded_ts'],
          'source_sha256':r['body_sha256'],
          'start_offset':r['start_offset'],'end_offset':r['end_offset'],
          'passage':chunk,'matched_terms':sorted(found),
          'search_score':round(score,3),
          'source_integrity_verified':False,
          'source_integrity_verification_tool':'gmri_get_passage',
          'retrieval_state':'literal_search_only_no_semantic_claim',
          } for score,r,chunk,found in selected]

    def _direct_propositions(self,question,limit=18):
        """Direct-source matching. It never invents conceptual equivalence."""

        ranked=[]
        for r in rows:
            quote=r['quote'].casefold().strip()
            words=set(safe_terms(quote))
            common=len(words.intersection(qterms))
            frac=common/max(1,len(qterms))
            if quote==q:score=300

    def archive_neighborhood(self,node_id,max_edges=50):
        """Traverse original graph edges; never infer causation from adjacency."""
        if not self.archive_db:raise ValueError('archive not configured')
        if not isinstance(node_id,str) or not node_id.strip():raise ValueError('node ID required')
        if not 1<=max_edges<=300:raise ValueError('edge limit exceeded')
        with readonly(self.archive_db) as c:
            anchor=c.execute('SELECT id,kind,label,source_id FROM nodes WHERE id=?',(node_id,)).fetchone()
            if anchor is None:raise KeyError(node_id)
            results=c.execute('''SELECT e.id,e.src,e.dst,e.relation,e.source_id,e.evidence_state,
                       n.id AS neighbor_id,n.label AS neighbor_label,n.kind AS neighbor_kind,
                       n.source_id AS neighbor_source_id,

                 FROM edges e JOIN nodes n ON n.id=(CASE WHEN e.src=? THEN e.dst ELSE e.src END)

        relations=[]

                'relations':relations,

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The assistant's intake tool. Unlike the viewer, this prints machine-ready evidence.

Usage:
  python gmri_agent.py preanswer 'question'
  python gmri_agent.py get-passage 1234
  python gmri_agent.py neighbors 'node-id'
  python gmri_agent.py bootstrap
  python gmri_agent.py status

No network, no external execution and no corpus edits. All outputs are JSON.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
from assistant_bridge import AssistantBridge

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DATA=ROOT/'DATA'


def main(argv=None):
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description='GMRI assistant evidence intake before answering')
    p.add_argument('--graph',default=str(DATA/'reasoning.sqlite'))
    p.add_argument('--archive',default=str(DATA/'archive.sqlite'))
    p.add_argument('--index',default=str(DATA/'passages.sqlite'))
    p.add_argument('--output')
    commands=p.add_subparsers(dest='command',required=True)
    q=commands.add_parser('preanswer');q.add_argument('question',nargs='+')
    q.add_argument('--passages',type=int,default=12)
    q.add_argument('--propositions',type=int,default=18)
    g=commands.add_parser('get-passage');g.add_argument('passage_id',type=int)
    n=commands.add_parser('neighbors');n.add_argument('node_id');n.add_argument('--max-edges',type=int,default=50)
    t=commands.add_parser('trace');t.add_argument('source_id');t.add_argument('--target-id')
    o=commands.add_parser('ooda');o.add_argument('cycle_id')
    commands.add_parser('bootstrap')
    commands.add_parser('status')
    a=p.parse_args(argv)
    client=AssistantBridge(a.graph,a.archive,a.index)
    if a.command=='preanswer':output=client.preanswer(' '.join(a.question),a.passages,a.propositions)
    elif a.command=='get-passage':output=client.get_passage(a.passage_id)
    elif a.command=='neighbors':output=client.archive_neighborhood(a.node_id,a.max_edges)
    elif a.command=='trace':output=client.trace(a.source_id,a.target_id)
    elif a.command=='ooda':output=client.ooda_targets(a.cycle_id)
    elif a.command=='bootstrap':output=client.bootstrap()
    else:output=client.status()
    dump=json.dumps(output,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)
    if a.output:Path(a.output).write_text(dump,encoding='utf8')
    else:print(dump)
    return output


if __name__=='__main__':main()

This package is designed for the assistant to read and reason over available research evidence **before** answering a GMRI question. Its primary interface is `gmri_preanswer`, exposed through standard MCP stdio or the `gmri_agent.py` JSON CLI.

## Authored governing instruction

> I told you yesterday, it needs to be usable for you. We're not building this for me. I know my reasoning. You're building this for you right now.

This is directly quoted from the current user conversation and has its own source SHA256 in the reasoning database.

## Assistant runtime contract

1. Before composing any response about GMRI, run `gmri_preanswer` with the user's original question verbatim. Do not replace it with a guessed easier question.
2. Read all `binding_instructions` as original user statements with source lineage; distinguish instructions from observations and hypotheses using the original text. The system automatically collects user-authored statements from the reasoning database; no manually selected list of "important" arguments is a data-admission rule.
3. Read `grounded_propositions` and inspect `typed_reasoning_edges`: each has a warrant and classification. Analyst candidates are NOT proofs. No factual conclusion follows merely because two files share words.
4. Read the top `archival_passages`, and call `gmri_get_passage` before presenting a consequential archival claim as verified. The tool checks original document SHA256 and the exact indexed substring.
5. Use `gmri_archive_neighbors` to navigate original archive structure, chronology, branches and references. These edges are **not** automatically logical/causal evidence.
6. For existing assessed cycles, use `gmri_trace`; for an existing Boydian cycle use `gmri_ooda_targets`. Assess new evidence, orientation, predicted consequences and feedback separately.
7. Answer from verified source statements first. Own interpretation must be explicitly differentiated; never silently rewrite the operator's premise, exclude a topic due to presumed importance, or claim a source has been ingested when bytes are unavailable.

## Command use in a local-capable assistant runtime

If this folder is available to the assistant's local execution tool:

```sh
python gmri_agent.py preanswer "How does the digital-person design integrate OODA feedback and the threat model?"
python gmri_agent.py get-passage 12345
python gmri_agent.py neighbors "some-archive-node-id"
python gmri_agent.py status
```

To register with an MCP stdio-compatible agent runtime, configure a server with:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "gmri-private-reasoning": {
      "command": "python",
      "args": ["/ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO/EXTRACTED/assistant_mcp.py"]
    }
  }
}
```

No remote service is deployed, no cloud corpus upload occurs, and no client is silently registered. ChatGPT needs a runtime mounting this package and an explicit tool invocation; merely producing an archive cannot force model calls in other conversations.

## Known data and epistemic scope

- Corpus in this bundle: **25,100 original archive nodes**, **83,475 pre-existing archival links**, **155,861 source-offset passages** indexed including duplicates and branches.
- Assessed reasoning is a **smaller separately warranted** graph; automated source searching does not itself reconstruct every proposition or empirically prove causal relationships.
- The previous Library inventory covered more items than the available raw source bytes. This package indexes **the full locally available archive**, not inaccessible original assets.
- Read-only tools fail on mutated source hashes, and the passage search does not silently claim source verification until `gmri_get_passage` is called.

"""Verify actual shipped databases and mandatory assistant call path."""
import hashlib
import json
import sqlite3
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from assistant_bridge import AssistantBridge
from assistant_index import readonly

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
EXPECTED=json.loads((ROOT/'RELEASE_VERIFICATION.json').read_text())


def sha256_file(path):
    digest=hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda:f.read(8*1024*1024),b''):digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def main():
    for basename, expected in EXPECTED['db_sha256'].items():
        path=ROOT/'DATA'/basename
        if sha256_file(path)!=expected:
            raise ValueError('database SHA256 mismatch '+basename)
        with readonly(path) as c:
            if c.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0]!='ok':
                raise ValueError('SQLite integrity error '+basename)
    b=AssistantBridge(ROOT/'DATA/reasoning.sqlite',ROOT/'DATA/archive.sqlite',ROOT/'DATA/passages.sqlite')
    status=b.status()
    assert status['archive_nodes']==EXPECTED['counts']['archive_nodes']
    assert int(status['passage_index']['passages'])==EXPECTED['counts']['passages']
    q=EXPECTED['acceptance_question']
    r=b.preanswer(q)
    ids={p['id'] for p in r['grounded_propositions']}
    if not set(EXPECTED['expected_grounded_propositions']).issubset(ids):
        raise AssertionError('assistant preanswer regression: missing original operator propositions')
    print(json.dumps({'status':'verified','archive_nodes':status['archive_nodes'],
          'indexed_passages':status['passage_index']['passages'],
          'grounded_propositions':len(r['grounded_propositions']),
          'original_archive_navigation_edges':len(r['archive_navigation_frontier'])},indent=2))

if __name__=='__main__':main()

OUT=Path('/mnt/data/GMRI_PRIVATE_ASSISTANT_REASONING_INTAKE_2026-10-29.zip')
FILES=[
 'ASSISTANT_FIRST_READ.md',
 'REASONING_SYSTEM_CONTRACT.md',

 'verify_release.py',
 'gmri_agent.py',
 'assistant_index.py',

 'patch_archive_time.py',
 'release_qa.py',
 'pytest.ini',
 'DATA/archive.sqlite',
 'DATA/reasoning.sqlite',
 'DATA/passages.sqlite',
]
for folder in ['EXPORT','tests']:
    FILES += [p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix() for p in (ROOT/folder).rglob('*')
              if p.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in p.parts and not p.name.startswith('.')] 
FILES=sorted(set(FILES))
with ZipFile(OUT,'w',compression=ZIP_DEFLATED,compresslevel=6,allowZip64=True) as z:

"""Create standalone, private, no-server graph with ALL locally indexed nodes/edges.
Not a complete source acquisition claim. Only excerpt previews; full originals stay
with authenticated local service. The offline file never calls an external network.
"""
import argparse,base64,gzip,json,sqlite3,html,os
from pathlib import Path

DIR=Path(__file__).resolve().parent

def build(archive,reasoning,outfile):
    con=sqlite3.connect(f'file:{Path(archive).resolve()}?mode=ro',uri=True)
    c2=sqlite3.connect(f'file:{Path(reasoning).resolve()}?mode=ro',uri=True)
    nodes=[]
    for id,kind,label,body,source,event,recorded in con.execute('SELECT id,kind,label,body,source_id,event_ts,recorded_ts FROM nodes'):
        nodes.append({'i':id,'k':kind,'t':(label or '')[:230], 'q':(body or '')[:650],
            's':source or '', 'e':event,'r':recorded,'c':'archive'})
    for id,quote,state,source,event,recorded,loc in c2.execute('''SELECT p.id,p.quote,p.state,p.source_id,s.event_at,s.recorded_at,s.locator
            FROM proposition p JOIN source_document s ON p.source_id=s.id'''):
        nodes.append({'i':id,'k':'assessed_proposition','t':quote[:190], 'q':quote[:1900],
            's':source,'e':event,'r':recorded,'c':'assessed','state':state,'loc':loc})
    edges=[]
    for id,src,dst,relation,status in con.execute('SELECT id,src,dst,relation,evidence_state FROM edges'):
        edges.append([src,dst,relation,status,'archive:'+str(id),'','archive'])
    for src,dst,kind,warrant,status in c2.execute('SELECT src,dst,kind,warrant,status FROM reasoning_relation'):
        edges.append([src,dst,kind,status, 'reason:'+src+':'+dst+':'+kind,warrant[:700],'assessed'])
    raw=json.dumps({'schema':'GMRI_OFFLINE_GRAPH_V1','nodes':nodes,'edges':edges,'scope':'All nodes and links in locally available Oct 29 GitHub + ChatGPT Library graph; excerpt previews only. Historical source inventory is partial.'},separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False).encode()
    packed=gzip.compress(raw,compresslevel=8)
    encoded=base64.b64encode(packed).decode('ascii')
    index=(DIR/'static/index.html').read_text()
    css=(DIR/'static/app.css').read_text()
    js=(DIR/'static/app.js').read_text()
    assert '</script>' not in js.lower()
    index=index.replace('<link rel="stylesheet" href="/app.css">','<style>'+css+'</style>')
    index=index.replace('<script src="/app.js"></script>', '<script id="gmri-seed" type="application/octet-stream">'+encoded+'</script><script>'+js+'</script>')
    # CSP prevents traffic from private file in offline version. Inline scripts required.
    index=index.replace('<meta name="theme-color"', '<meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src \'none\'; script-src \'unsafe-inline\'; style-src \'unsafe-inline\'; img-src data:; connect-src \'none\'; base-uri \'none\'; form-action \'none\'"><meta name="theme-color"')
    Path(outfile).parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    Path(outfile).write_text(index)
    return {'node_count':len(nodes),'edge_count':len(edges),'json_bytes':len(raw),'gzip_bytes':len(packed),'standalone_html_bytes':Path(outfile).stat().st_size}

if __name__=='__main__':
 p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--archive',required=True);p.add_argument('--reasoning',required=True);p.add_argument('--out',required=True);a=p.parse_args()
 print(json.dumps(build(a.archive,a.reasoning,a.out),indent=2))

def test_assistant_mcp_reads_same_focus_and_teaching_ledger(studio):
